limitations_and_boundaries: The empirical evaluation of over-smoothing mitigation methods is qualitative, based on Dirichlet energy plots, without quantitative performance metrics.
The study focuses on over-smoothing and does not address other deep GNN issues like over-squashing or vanishing gradients.
The conclusion that mitigating over-smoothing is not sufficient is based on illustrative examples and may not generalize to all tasks or architectures.

research_questions.statement: How can over-smoothing in GNNs be axiomatically defined and measured?

provenance.text_excerpt: we test the qualitative behavior of those measures on three different graph datasets, i.e., small-scale Texas graph, medium-scale Cora graph, and large-scale Cornell5 graph, and observe an exponential convergence to zero of all measures for standard GNN models (i.e., GCN, GAT, and GraphSAGE).

claims.statement: Standard GNNs (GCN, GAT, GraphSAGE) exhibit exponential convergence of node-similarity measures to zero.

provenance.text_excerpt: we axiomatically define as the exponential convergence of suitable similarity measures on the node features.

claims.statement: Over-smoothing can be axiomatically defined as the exponential convergence of node-similarity measures.

experiments_or_tasks: Define over-smoothing axiomatically as the exponential convergence of suitable similarity measures on node features.
Empirically demonstrate exponential convergence of similarity measures on small-, medium-, and large-scale graphs for standard GNNs (GCN, GAT, GraphSAGE).
Review existing node-similarity measures (e.g., Dirichlet energy, cosine similarity) and unify them under the definition.

methods.name: Over-smoothing definition
methods.protocol_description: Over-smoothing is defined as the exponential convergence of a node-similarity measure μ to zero as the number of layers increases: μ(X(n)) ≤ C1 e^{-C2 n} for constants C1, C2 > 0.

methods.name: DropEdge
methods.protocol_description: Randomly drop edges during training to regularize message passing.

methods.protocol_description: Normalize node features to prevent feature divergence.

methods.protocol_description: Use a graph-coupled oscillator system to model GNN dynamics.

methods.name: G2
methods.protocol_description: Gradient Gating: learnable node-wise early-stopping mechanism using graph-gradient gating.

methods.protocol_description: GCN with residual connection: Xn = Xn-1 + F_θn(Xn-1, G).

methods.protocol_description: GCN with initial residual connection and identity mapping: Xn = σ(((1-αn) D^{-1/2} A D^{-1/2} Xn-1 + αn X0) ((1-βn)I + βn Wn)).
